history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young man, seen from behind, stands near a body of water under a cloudy sky. He is wearing a black t-shirt with white text printed on the back that reads "EMAK MURENG PANGGIL MANCING". He has dark, somewhat messy hair and is holding a cigarette to his lips with his right hand. A fishing rod is slung over his left shoulder, with a pink reel attached to it. The background features a calm body of water, with lush green trees and vegetation lining the distant shore. A building with an orange roof is visible among the trees. The overall lighting is diffused due to the overcast sky, creating a slightly muted color palette with a focus on the dark t-shirt and the greens and blues of the environment. The mood is contemplative and perhaps a bit melancholic, suggested by the cloudy sky and the man's solitary posture. The style is realistic, capturing a candid moment outdoors.
